product: Kredible finances the blocked account (Sperrkonto), tuition fees and first-year living costs for admitted non-EU students at German universities. For the university it costs nothing: no fees, no revenue share, no repayment risk. Tuition is paid directly to the institution, and the university is told when a student's funding is secured. Benefits: fewer admitted students lost between offer and enrolment, a wider talent pool, graduates who stay in Germany.

signals.label: Application deadline extensions (unfilled seats)
signals.query: site:{domain} ("Bewerbungsfrist verlängert" OR "Frist verlängert" OR "deadline extended" OR "application period reopened")
signals.hint: Strongest signal: extended or reopened deadlines mean unfilled seats.

signals.label: Admitted students who cannot fund their studies (Reddit)
signals.query: site:reddit.com "{name}" ("blocked account" OR Sperrkonto OR "proof of funds" OR "can't afford")
signals.hint: Students of this university publicly struggling with the blocked account.

signals.label: Government and regulation changes
signals.query: (Sperrkonto OR Studienvisum OR Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetz OR "Studiengebühren Nicht-EU" OR "international students" Germany) (Gesetz OR Verordnung OR regulation OR Erhöhung) after:{since}
signals.hint: Rule changes that make funding harder for non-EU students raise urgency for every university.

signals.label: Funding and budgets
signals.query: "{name}" (Förderung OR Fördermittel OR DAAD OR Exzellenzstrategie OR funding OR grant) after:{since}
signals.hint: New budgets for internationalisation make projects easier to start.

signals.label: Job vacancies: needs written in the ad text
signals.query: "{name}" (Stellenausschreibung OR Stellenangebot OR job OR vacancy) ("International Office" OR Zulassung OR Admissions OR "international students")
signals.hint: Read the ad text for needs: workload, new processes, tools, international growth targets.

signals.label: Latest news
signals.hint: What is happening at the organisation right now.

email_brief: Thank them, mention that colleagues from their organisation signed up too (no names), explain in three sentences how the product helps them at no cost or risk, offer a 20-minute call, and end with: Reply STOP to unsubscribe. Write in German for German organisations, otherwise English.
